description: This file defines the 'File' class for handling File Property Storage (PPS) within OLE containers in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It extends the PPS class and provides methods for initialization and appending data to a file object in an OLE compound document structure.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class for creating and managing File PPS objects within OLE compound documents, allowing for data appending and initialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new File PPS object with a specified filename in Unicode.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the File PPS object. Always returns true.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends data to the PPS object's internal data buffer.
